# Definitions.net

> > Comprehensive online dictionary providing detailed definitions, translations, and usage examples for Chinese characters, terms, and phrases in both simplified and traditional forms.

Definitions.net is a multilingual dictionary platform operated by STANDS4 LTD, specializing in Chinese language reference materials including character definitions, compound words, geographic terms, and phrase translations. The site serves as a reference tool for understanding Chinese vocabulary with detailed etymological and contextual information.

## Key Topics

- Chinese characters
- Simplified Chinese
- Traditional Chinese
- Dictionary definitions
- Character compounds
- Chinese language reference
- Word translations
- Compound words
- Chinese terms
- Geographic place names
- Language learning
- Etymology
- Usage examples

## Chinese Character Definitions

- [千千](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/千千): Chinese character definition for 千千 with translations and meanings
- [备](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/备): Chinese character definition for 备 including compound words and usage
- [威威](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/威威): Traditional Chinese term 威威 definition with translations
- [乌](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/乌): Chinese character 乌 definition with geographic place names and compounds

## Chinese Phrases & Expressions

- [惹不得](https://chinese.definitions.net/def/ZH/惹不得): Simplified Chinese phrase 惹不得 definition and translations
